description: This file defines the HolidayMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to set up menu configurations for holiday-related screens in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It overrides the screen to 'viewHolidayList'.

classes.name: HolidayMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for holiday screens in the leave plugin by overriding specific screens.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewHolidayList' in the module's context.
